entries.say.variants.default: We're running low on canned goods and spare batteries, {addressee.name}. Think we can make a quick run {scene.location}?
entries.reply.agreed.say.variants.default: Alright, {addressee.name}. Pack light, keep the crowbar handy, and we stick to the side streets.
entries.reply.deferred.say.variants.default: Better to wait for first light. Fog's too thick out by the highway right now.
entries.reply.assessed.say.variants.default: Roads looked quiet earlier {scene.location}, {addressee.name}, though there's always a few stragglers near the gas station.
entries.reply.refused.say.variants.default: No sense going out there right now. Stay put until it's safe.
entries.reply.postpone.say.variants.default: Hold off moving out until the storm breaks and visibility clears.
entries.reply.reroute.say.variants.default: Take the service alley west instead—avoids the ambush stretch completely.
entries.reply.request_escort.say.variants.defaul: I'll run that stretch only if we bring a second gun along for cover.
entries.reply.reluctant.say.variants.default: I don't love the odds on that road, {addressee.name}, though I'll tag along carefully.
